title.narrative: Innovation in Investigative Journalism: Data & Art

description.narrative:
This project aims to strengthen and enrich an innovative, connected, and data-driven sustainable ecosystem of investigative reporting by employing two distinct yet important approaches: data and art.
Outcomes: this project was designed with key activities that will lead to the following 4 outcomes: 1. Facilitating a training diploma for Arab investigative journalists to empower, support, and elevate their capabilities, knowledge, and skills in data-driven journalism. 2. Increase the spreading of powerful, high-quality, accountable, and verified investigative content by publishing quality and verified investigations to a better informed and aware public. 3. Generate and amplify interest and engagement in investigative journalism from the public by incorporating innovative and creative storytelling techniques. 4. Elevate investigative journalism's community-building aspect by offering journalists opportunities to network with the community and new avenues for collaboration.
